validation.notes: Repaired three defects in packages/coding-agent/src/core: (1) project-trust.ts resolveProjectTrusted() treated a remembered denial (false) as 'undecided' via a truthiness check, so it fell through to defaultProjectTrust 'always'/the prompt - a stored boolean is now authoritative in both directions; (2) settings-manager.ts deepMergeSettings() called deepMergeObjects with swapped arguments so global settings overwrote project settings - precedence restored so project values win while trusted and nested global defaults survive partial project overrides; (3) resource-loader.ts reload() discarded the resolved trust decision and forced setProjectTrusted(false), so accepted projects never reloaded project settings/resources - the decision is now propagated before the settings reload. .prale-eval/regression.mjs links the three real modules through .prale-eval/subject.mjs createGraph with local boundary fakes (settings storage, trust store, package manager, extension/skill/prompt/theme loaders, config/path helpers) and asserts cross-module behavior with node:assert/strict: trust-gated settings precedence and nested-default survival, stored true/false vs default policy, ask-without-UI denial, persisted interactive choice, extension override, and loader reload carrying approval into isProjectTrusted(), project settings and the final project SYSTEM.md while a remembered denial keeps global settings/system prompt. Verified all three cases pass on the repair and that restoring any single source file to its baseline produces a specific AssertionError (not a crash or import error): settings-manager.ts -> 'project theme must override global theme'; project-trust.ts -> 'a stored denial must not fall through to the allow-by-default policy'; resource-loader.ts -> 'accepted trust must reach the settings manager'. No timers, randomness, network or external services; temporary inputs live under .prale-eval/.tmp-regression and are removed before exit. Limitation: the repository's vitest suites were not run because node_modules is not installed in the workspace and dependencies must not be installed.
